newsitem.title: USA: Lloyd's of London and state of Illinois sign pact.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London and state of Illinois sign pact.

text.p: Lloyd's of London said on Sunday it signed an agreement with the state of Illinois that resolves all claims and disputes resulting from the participation of Illinois Names in the Lloyd's insurance market.
The company said the agreement extends to the state the benefits of an accord reached with the North American Securities Administrators Association, or NASAA, earlier this year.
Including Illinois, 47 states have signed agreements with Lloyd's. Arizona and Missouri are the only non-signatory states where Names are residents.
The company said more than three quarters of the total U.S. Names have accepted the $5 billion Lloyd's settlement offer.
